title: Native Root Owned Prefix Scratch
objective: Qualify fixed root-owned logical-prefix scratch for repeated resident helper calls

oracles: Same-source dynamic JavaScript, native GMP, and native fmpz agreement
Exact determinant-30 row-lattice proof and HNF/dependency/LLL transform identities
Generated GMP/fmpz entry ASan/UBSan exhaustion, exception, retained-parent and publication checks

handoff.summary: Choose the simpler fixed-root alternative: qualify four existing logical-prefix FLINT matrix operations for fmpz, without adding borrowed-arena syntax, child owners, checkpoint rewinds, or new native code. A same-source witness repeatedly attempts 2/6/4/6 logical rows using borrowed root-owned scratch. Dynamic/GMP/fmpz differential tests and isolated generated GMP/fmpz sanitizer tests pass; maximum witness checkpoint high-water was 201136 bytes (fmpz) and 208640 bytes (GMP), with no upstream checkpoint allocations. Architecture, merge inventories and strict Python checks pass. Builds used isolated temporary native caches and a read-only prepared FLINT/compiler/parser installation; root and opt were untouched.
risks: This establishes the integer-lattice mechanism, not extraction or performance of the complete class-group suffix. Capacities must follow actual stage bounds rather than the global 1024-row maximum.

BF interval evaluation currently consumes whole matrix shapes; fixed positive-one padding is mathematically possible but has not been implemented or timed in the actual suffix. A logical-prefix interval adapter may be preferable.
Checkpoint bump high-water accumulates across attempts; root-owned matrices live until the outer exit. The witness does not prove the complete cubic suffix fits the unchanged 3 MiB cap.
Full changed-check build/unit/compiler/integration and platform-native suites remain pending. Windows and Wasm were not executed locally; keep the contract active pending integration validation.
next_steps: Integrate separately from PR123's bounded guard; do not alter the frozen opt census/timing snapshot.
Extract proof attempts using typed borrowed scratch parameters and explicit logical dimensions; preserve raw relation/witness state and distinguish recoverable insufficiency from invalid execution.
Measure full-suffix root memory and total attempt cost before deciding whether a more general shared-budget child-resource API is necessary.
